cost_scope: Logical unchanged weight bytes; added in-stream Switch and actual emitted DMA packets require whole-path measurement. Whole timings include all costs, not measured traffic or exclusive bus stalls.
scope: O K1024/low2 row ownership ingress and Main InterTranspose restore the original K256/row60 native consumer. E147 quantizer, four terms, coefficients, native Term/K16 reduction and entire epilogue remain. QKV/FFN images unchanged; original reference boundary checks remain separate.

adoption.reason: This single allocation did not show a net gain. Preserve it; root decides whether a concrete unresolved variance or implementation issue justifies another check.

further_tuning.reason: 5% is a provisional additional-tuning budget, not an adoption minimum. No tile sweep is authorized by this report.

major_research.question: Does original 60-row weight ingress with K1024 low2 row ownership and an in-stream Main InterTranspose shorten the limiting last-weight preparation, including routing/collect backpressure? E147 quantizer, numerical order and native2 remain unchanged.

decisions.decision_owner: Root reviewer; these are evidence-based proposed next actions, not an automatic adoption.
